method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18 and the writing-l4-rules skill; the duties ss 68 and 79 put on courts are regulative rules (PARTY ... SHANT/MAY ... LEST BREACH ... BECAUSE), and the seat questions read the same definitions; no REFUSE (a charge that is not for a Commonwealth offence, in a court not otherwise exercising federal jurisdiction, answers `not covered`, asserted); every satisfaction of the court asked as an input; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98, JL4_LIBRARY_PATH unset. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
